title: Tasks
body: This app has been amazing for keeping track of tasks I need to do and allowing me to plan my days thoroughly.
author: girufigidafi

title: Good for free. Very basic.
body:
No month view, can only see the active week so hard to review progress. Literally have to skip back one day at a time. 

No date filter to check progress between dates and no search so you cannot go back and review or change previous days without, again, skipping back a single day at a time. 

Would be useful to be able to choose a task and get completion statistics filterable by week, month, year and selectable time frames. 

Again, decent for free.
author: Jamzzzzzzs
